params.caption: 🖥️ Intel 18A yields reach 70% as Microsoft signs on for EMIB Intel says yields on its 18A process have hit 70%, a key milestone for its next-gen chips. It also signed a long-term Xeon supply deal with Microsoft, which becomes the first company to publicly commit to Intel's EMIB packaging technology. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 16:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👥 @intel · @Microsoft 🔧 React if Intel is back in the game · 💬 Team Intel or Team AMD? #Intel #Intel18A #Microsoft #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
